title: JUMVI Locked Physical Principles
description: Pinned, versioned physical-design law for the real JUMVI Toss & Catch paddle set. `enforced: true` constraints are deterministically checked (a hard fail, no auditor discretion). `enforced: false` entries are informational -- they describe the product's real behavioral envelope and are fed to the Auditor's own review, but their absence from a candidate's wording is never itself grounds for an automatic reject (see meta_rules.behavioral_risk_not_auto_reject).

hard_constraints.description: catching / receiving / presenting paddle / repositioning / supported transfer behavior only -- informational envelope, fed to the Auditor, never enforced by absence
do not assume rebound, bouncing, racket-style striking, or paddle-propelled throwing

judgment_required_constraints.description: impossible simultaneous states fail (e.g. more concurrent possessors claimed than ball_count allows)

meta_rules.behavioral_risk_not_auto_reject: behavioral risk must NOT be promoted into a physical hard reject unless a formal hard constraint is actually satisfied
meta_rules.unknown_stays_unknown: UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN and must be routed to validation (REVISE_AND_REAUDIT) rather than guessed or silently approved
